utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — the repair drive is this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community shed on Maple Street, and I’ll keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Opal — I’ll pass that along and keep folks in the loop. Appreciate you helping keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Glad to help — just let me know if anything changes, and I’ll keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered, but I’ll send the date, time, and location, and I’ll bring any spare tools or screws I can find.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — send the details when you can, and I’ll join a bit late but jump in on the tools list and front gate once I’m there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll send the details soon and keep an eye out for anything useful in the toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to hear — sounds like you’re making progress. Let me know if you need anything while you’re checking on the rest.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Ira — I’m still waiting on the exact day and time so I can lock in the school pickup plan. If you hear anything first, could you let me know?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I hear the repair drive details. Hope the pickup plan gets set soon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep you posted on the repair drive, and I’m happy to repeat the details once they’re set.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Sam — I appreciate that a lot. Send me the details when they’re ready, and I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn — I really appreciate you helping spread the word. I’ll send the repair drive details as soon as they’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, good — bring it by and we’ll see what we can do. I’ll keep my ears open for that wrench and any other handy fixes folks need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds great, Tess — I’ll round up the wrench and check in on any other fixes folks bring up. Thanks for keeping an ear out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, wonderful — that’ll help a lot. Swing by when you can, and I’ll keep folks pointed your way if they need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It’s moving along okay so far—I’ve got a few things sorted and I’m still checking on the rest.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Good to hear — I’ll keep repeating the repair drive plan as it comes together and pass along any updates so everyone stays in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Vik — that helps. I’m still working through the rest, so keep me posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Oren. If you can help with the repair drive, I’d be grateful—starting with the front gate would help me most.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I can take a look at the front gate and bring that squeaky chair by too, in case anyone’s got a wrench handy.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Oren. That would help a lot—please start with the front gate, and bring the chair along too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll start with the front gate and tighten anything loose. I’ll let you know if I spot anything else.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Leo — please keep me posted if you find anything else, and let me know once the repair drive date is set.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll keep you posted and let you know as soon as the repair drive date is set.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard it’s getting organized so far—tools, parts, and volunteers are all coming together. If you’ve got the final time, I can pass it along and bring my wrench and an hour too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Nell — I’ll send the final time as soon as I have it, and your wrench and an hour would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I’ll keep an ear out and pass it along once you send it. I’m ready to bring the wrench and help for an hour when the time’s set.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you send me the date, time, and location for the repair drive, plus anything you’re planning to bring? I want to keep the details straight before I help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Of course — send me the date, time, and location, and I’ll keep it straight. I’m happy to bring whatever you need if you let me know.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Eli — I’ll send the date, time, and location, plus any item list once I have it, so we can keep everything accurate.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes — it’s still on for today, and I’ll text you right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — you’re sure it’s still on for today, right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, still on for today — I’ll text you immediately if that changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Cleo — send me the details and I’ll line up the tools and checklist so we’re ready for the Sunday community center repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Not yet, Rosa — I’m still checking the supply list, but I’ll send the date and time as soon as it’s locked in so you can get the tools and checklist ready.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — that works. I’ll keep the tools and checklist ready, and send the time along as soon as you have it.
